compute_accuracy_predictions: compute model accuracy by comparing predicted tokens against target tokens excluding the CLS token
validate_model_on_dataset: validate a transformer model on a dataset and print accuracy and loss metrics
run_validation_loop: run a validation loop over a dataset using a tokenizer and model to compute accuracy
test_compute_accuracy: test the compute_accuracy function with model outputs, targets, and a tokenizer
review_validate_function: review the validate function that iterates over a dataset and computes model accuracy and loss
